page.overview:
Who is Aquaria?

Queen Aquaria is a minor character in Invincible. She was the wife of King Aquarus, the King of Atlantis and a former member of the Guardians of the Globe.

Aquaria appears as an anthropomorphic fish with a humanoid body. She possesses fins extending from her head and back, webbed arms and legs, and light blue skin.

She wears a flowing dark blue gown with matching armor-like shoulder pieces and a golden tiara adorned with a purple gemstone at its centre.

Unlike her late husband, Aquarus, Queen Aquaria takes her royal duties very seriously and places the welfare of Atlantis above the concerns of the surface world. Following Aquarus’s death, she upholds Atlantean law by holding Invincible, as Nolan’s next of kin, accountable for the king’s murder. Despite her stern and authoritative demeanor, she is pragmatic rather than cruel, having abolished the kingdom’s former marriage custom as barbaric. After Invincible risks his life to save both her and her people from the Depth-Dweller, she considers Aquarus’s death atoned for and ends the matter.
